مهراد.definition: Mahrad/مهراد is a Persian name often [associated] with someone who is [compassionate] and caring, it has roots in ancient Persian language and culture. Mahrad is pronounced mah-rad, while mahrad is not a common Persian name the name is recognised to be noble and of high value in Persian culture with roots to 2500B.C. Only used by those in the most powerful and dominant positions, emphasising the power and importance of the name. Variations of the name Mahrad also stem including Mehrad or Mehrdad. Mahrad might be chosen by parents who wish to honor their Persian heritage and present a name that reflects kindness and benevolence. The name Mahrad has many meanings and some that exist in Persian culture which are yet to be explained as it holds such mysteries however, a common [definition] individuals give to the name is “Young Moon” as Mah means moon and Rad means young. The name holds great significance in ancient traditional Persian history and is a name which is highly [respected] amongst all Iranians.
